item.title: The Rundown - Monday: SharePoint sharing, one real payment, the father brain
item.description: Three items. Microsoft's SharePoint/OneDrive sharing default flips before late October and the presenter's site-level override claim looks wrong - check MC1454378 yourself. EWS retirement quietly takes cross-tenant calendar sharing with it; run Get-OrganizationRelationship to find the blast radius. The SMS MFA hard date is 1 Feb 2027, not September. Dan Martell's three questions for a one-person AI business, with the thing to actually do: one-page offer, ten MSPs, ask for a paid pilot this week - but not via his take-a-real-card trick. And the exploration pick: the father-brain episode this engine wrongly binned, where the usable finding is validation as the opener in any argument.

item.title: The Rundown - Sun 30 Aug: memberOf deadline, who pays for your tokens
item.description: Three items, 2 minutes. Entra memberOf retires 3 Nov 2026 - dynamic groups freeze silently and group-based licensing drifts with them. Ed Zitron on AI token economics: a 200-dollar plan can burn ~14k of tokens; Uber capped 1500 per seat per month. Defender+Intune video is positioning, not how-to - two claims that don't survive checking. 9 items rejected, listed with chapters in the summary email.
